question: Who is the chairperson of the RBI constituted committee on development of housing finance securitisation market?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harsh Vardhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harsh Vardhan** is a seasoned banker with extensive experience in the financial sector.
 
• He has been actively involved in the development of the housing finance market in India.
 
• Harsh Vardhan has served in various capacities in different financial institutions, contributing to their growth and development.
 
• He was appointed as the chairperson of the committee constituted by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to develop and enhance the housing finance securitisation market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**

 
 
• The Reserve Bank of India is India's central banking institution, which controls the issuance and supply of the Indian rupee.
 
• It was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• The RBI plays a crucial role in the development and regulation of the financial sector in India.
 
• It aims to foster financial stability and ensure adequate flow of credit to productive sectors.
 
 
 
• **Securitisation Market**
 
 
• Securitisation is the financial practice of pooling various types of contractual debt such as mortgages, auto loans, or credit card debt obligations and selling their related cash flows to third-party investors as securities.
 
• These securities are backed by the underlying debt obligations, providing investors with a stream of income.
 
• The securitisation market enables financial institutions to manage their capital more efficiently and diversify their risk.
 
• It also provides investors with access to a diversified portfolio of debt instruments.
 
 
 
• **Housing Finance**
 
 
• Housing finance refers to the funding of housing projects and the provision of loans to individuals for purchasing or constructing homes.
 
• It plays a critical role in the development of the housing sector, which is a key component of the economy.
 
• Financial institutions such as banks and housing finance companies provide housing loans to individuals and developers.
 
• The development of a robust housing finance market is essential for ensuring adequate and affordable housing for the population.
